metadata.page_title: Pat Pidgeon vs Squat matchup report

summary.decision_summary: Pat Pidgeon won by 2.2. Pat Pidgeon left 42.9 lineup points on the table, while Squat left 8.3.
summary.historical_summary: Pat Pidgeon is 13-7 against Squat across 20 meetings between these managers.
summary.ideal_summary: Ideal lineups still favor Pat Pidgeon
summary.winner_reason: Pat Pidgeon won by 2.2, led by a 13.5-point edge at WR. The leading starters were Jaxon Smith-Njigba (30.3) and C.J. Stroud (21.5).
summary.loser_reason: Squat could not match the opponent's WR production, losing that position battle by 13.5 points. Jalen Coker scored 0.9. Its best legal lineup added 8.3, enough to put the lineup decisions directly in the result.
